Execute a sequence of multiple actions (click, type, click) and verify all succeed with correct indices

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { PageAction, createEngine, interact } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { browser: { mode: "always" } };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await interact(engine, url, [{ selector: "#open", type: "click" } as PageAction, { selector: "#field", text: "test_data", type: "type" } as PageAction, { selector: "#submit", type: "click" } as PageAction]);
  console.log(result.actionResults[0].actionIndex);
  console.log(result.actionResults[0].actionType);
  console.log(result.actionResults[0].success);
  console.log(result.actionResults[1].actionIndex);
  console.log(result.actionResults[1].actionType);
  console.log(result.actionResults[1].success);
  console.log(result.actionResults[2].actionIndex);
  console.log(result.actionResults[2].actionType);
  console.log(result.actionResults[2].success);
}

void main();
```
